content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius city district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property one party was granted a vehicle while the other party was granted an apartment the court also recognized a debt that was jointly taken by both spouses during their marriage the specific laws that apply in this case are the civil code which addresses the fulfillment of obligations by spouses and the right to compensation the court has granted the divorce and divided the property with the applicant receiving the apartment and the car and the defendant keeping the other apartment the defendant is responsible for paying the applicants legal costs the court has considered the circumstances of the case and determined that it is fair for each spouse to keep the property they have been occupying the court has also recognized the credit debt as a joint several obligation between the parties the applicant has been ordered to pay the costs of the proceedings and the defendant has been ordered to pay the applicants costs and the costs for the service of procedural documents to the state
